answer: my mechanism: bonded vouching with slashable guarantors. a fresh id can only attest once two established peers escrow real stake behind it, each signature a quill stroke on a permanent ledger. if that id is later convicted of sybil behavior, both escrows are slashed and the id's bond burns. a farm must then post at-risk capital per clone or corrupt guarantors who lose everything when caught — mass identities stop being free. every vouch is a knoll cairn on the network's voyage: visible, attributable, punishable.
